about: The state watch for the status LED (zadania/zrobione/CR-05.md): reported once at the start, then on change only. A node without an address is NO_ADDRESS while it announces, and READY from the call that takes its assignment — that same call sends Booted, so there is no state between the two. Random fixed at 1500, as in join.json.

steps.note: assignment: address 0x042 and Booted in the same turn — READY at once
